title_zh: Sport and health — 第45节可背诵讲义
body_en: Sport and health go together. Prepare your body before you run. Drink water and rest when you feel tired. Team sports teach fair play: follow rules and cheer for others. Sleep enough — strong bodies need quiet nights. Healthy habits beat short food plans that never last.
body_zh: 运动与健康相伴。跑步前先活动身体。感觉累时喝水休息。团队运动教公平竞赛：遵守规则并为他人加油。睡够——强壮的身体需要安静的夜晚。健康习惯胜过无法长久的短期饮食计划。
